✈️ Understanding TCAS (Traffic Collision Avoidance System)

🔍 TCAS helps pilots detect and avoid potential mid-air collisions by providing visual and audio alerts based on nearby traffic.

Here’s what the symbols mean on your display:

🟦 Diamond = Other Aircraft
🔷 Filled Diamond = Proximate Aircraft
🟡 Circle = Potential Threat (TA - Traffic Advisory)
🟥 Square = Collision Threat (RA - Resolution Advisory)
📶 Arrow & Numbers = Vertical trend & relative altitude in hundreds of feet

✅ TCAS enhances situational awareness and is a crucial part of modern air safety.

📸 by fb/atplquestions , thepilotcenter
